subject: Life Skills
title: The Amygdala Hijack
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Amygdala Hijack.

hook.text: You've said things in anger you instantly regretted. That's your amygdala overriding your rational brain.

buildup.text: The amygdala processes threats faster than the prefrontal cortex processes reason. Emotion beats logic speed.

discovery.text: Daniel Goleman called this an amygdala hijack: emotions seize control before rational thought can intervene.

twist.text: The hijack lasts about 20 minutes. After that, the rational brain regains control and you think clearly.

climax.text: When flooded, say 'I need a moment' and step away. Twenty minutes of pause prevents hours of damage.

punchline.text: Step away for twenty minutes. Return with your brain.

quiz.question: How long does an amygdala hijack typically last?
